workloads.name: collection_map_lookup_objects_1024
workloads.setup:
var collectionKeys=[];for(var j=0;j<1024;j++)collectionKeys.push({id:j});var collectionFixture=new Map();for(var i=0;i<1024;i++)collectionFixture.set(collectionKeys[i],i);
function bench(){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<1024;i++)s+=collectionFixture.get(collectionKeys[i]);return s;}

workloads.name: collection_set_has_1024
workloads.setup:
var collectionFixture=new Set();for(var i=0;i<1024;i++)collectionFixture.add(i);
function bench(){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<1024;i++){if(collectionFixture.has(i))s++;if(collectionFixture.has(i+1024))s++;}return s;}
